heading.title: Of the Payment and Apportionment of Annuities

article.title: Commencement of annuity when no time fixed by will.
article.content: Where an annuity is given by a will and no time is fixed for its commencement, it shall commence from the testator’s death, and the first payment shall be made at the expiration of a year next after that event.
article.html:
338Commencement of annuity when no time fixed by will.

Section 338 · Part IX · Chapter IX · page 87 of the Act

Where an annuity is given by a will and no time is fixed for its commencement, it shall commence from the testator’s death, and the first payment shall be made at the expiration of a year next after that event.
